title: FTP server restarts automatically after being turned off and exiting the app

full_report.title: FTP server restarts automatically after being turned off and exiting the app
full_report.observed_behavior: On the FTP server screen, if the user turns the server off and then exits the app using the Back button, the FTP server restarted on its own.
full_report.expected_behavior: The FTP server should stay off after turning the server off and exiting the app.
full_report.steps_to_reproduce:
1. From the main Files screen, tap the Navigate up button to open the navigation drawer.
2. In the navigation drawer, tap FTP server.
3. On the FTP server screen, tap the Status switch to turn the server off.
4. Press the Back button to exit the app.

ground_truth.info_elements_gt:
Buggy Behavior: the server restarts automatically
Triggering GUI Interaction: stops the FTP server and then closes the app
Triggering Screen Reference: FTP server screen
Correct Behavior: The FTP server should remain stopped
